root_causes.description: The payment service (a leaf dependency of checkout) shows its own SERVER-span p99 pinned at the 10000ms ceiling with normal CPU, flat memory, zero restarts and no error logs, indicating an injected/induced latency fault local to payment rather than resource pressure or a downstream dependency.

evidence.expected_baseline: cpu_usage ~0.005-0.01 cores; would spike under cpu_stress

evidence.observed_value: memory=202543104 bytes (~193 MiB), stable across window
evidence.expected_baseline: stable working-set; would climb under memory_stress
no error logs during healthy operation -> confirms latency, not errors

root_causes.description: checkout's SERVER-span p99 is also pinned at 10000ms because it blocks synchronously on the slow payment call; its own error rate is zero and non-payment children (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping) are healthy, so the checkout latency is inherited propagation rather than a checkout-local fault.

evidence.expected_baseline: checkout p99 ~ tens of ms; elevated only because it waits on payment
error_rate < 0.01; zero here rules out http_abort/dependency errors

root_causes.description: frontend inherits the latency end-to-end: its SERVER-span p99 is pinned at 10000ms purely because it calls the slow checkout/payment path through checkout; its other dependencies (recommendation, product-catalog) are healthy, confirming this is downstream-driven, not frontend-local.

evidence.expected_baseline: frontend p99 ~ hundreds of ms; elevated due to slow checkout->payment
p99 < 50ms -> other frontend dependencies are healthy

remediation_steps: Inspect the payment service deployment for an injected latency fault (e.g. flagd fault-injection flag such as 'paymentLatency' / a sleep or network-delay injection) and disable/roll it back.
Check payment pod/network for added latency (sidecar or tc netem delay); restart/redeploy the payment pod to clear the injected delay if a flag is not the source.
Add/verify a client timeout and circuit breaker on checkout's call to payment so a single slow leaf dependency cannot pin frontend p99 at the 10s ceiling.
Confirm latency returns to baseline (payment p99 < 50ms, checkout/frontend p99 back to sub-second) and validate with user_checkout traces.
